children.value: prahrāda iti saṃcintya kṛtvā nārāyaṇīṃ tanum
viṣṇordveṣaṃ parityajya bhaktā daityāḥ sthitā iti
te hi tanmayatāṃ yātā māyeyamiti bhāvyate
nopapannaṃ hi yadyatra tatra tatra virājate
yo yo yādṛgguṇo jantuḥ sa tāmevaiti saṃsthitim
sadṛśeṣvapyajeṣu śvā na madhye ramate kvacit
tadeva rājate tatra jale'mbhojaṃ natu sthale

kamalinī paruṣoṣarabhūgatā
sukhayatīha yathā na durāśrayā

ditisuto'pi hi mādhavabhaktimā-
niti kathā na tatheśa sukhāya naḥ
